name: G N A Axles Limited
about: G N A Axles Limited manufactures automotive transmission components for original equipment manufacturers in North America, Europe, South America, Australia, and Asia. The company offers rear axle shafts, spindles, and drive shafts, as well as non-flanged shafts. Its products are used in commercial vehicles, passenger vehicles, and off-highway vehicles. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Hoshiarpur, India.
